qualifications: Observed retained provider responses, not an account invoice. Unknown-usage failed requests are not assigned zero billable cost.
Response ids deduplicate copied evidence; independent responses with equal token counts remain separate.
Canonical ownership is the first retained source path; cohort aggregates are accounting buckets, not homogeneous experimental groups.
Cached input and reasoning output are subsets, never added again.
Setup, diagnostic replays, normal online episodes and System2 proposal costs are retained separately.
No API is called by this inventory.
